title: Novel artificial intelligence-enabled deep learning system to enhance adenoma detection: a prospective randomized controlled study
summary: A prospective randomized study of 674 white-light colonoscopies found higher adenoma detection with the DEEP2 computer-aided detection system (37% vs 27%; 122/330 vs 93/344) and more adenomas per colonoscopy, with about four false alerts per AI exam. The result is a limited single-center clinical detection outcome. Randomized 1:1 comparison, 1,033 enrolled and 674 analyzed after protocol exclusions; pathology-confirmed lesions; ADR and APC; unblinded study, single center, false alerts recorded by endoscopists. Existing catalog 2020 CADe trial is a different paper/system and cohort; not same result.
